ticketing.tiers_description: Manage tariffs, options, quotas and items to be returned

ticketing.all_artists_handout_items_help: These items are handed out to every artist of the edition, in addition to those linked to their shows.
ticketing.infomaniak_currency_mismatch: Infomaniak will return amounts in {infomaniak}, while the edition is set to {edition}: they would be displayed in the wrong currency. Align both settings.
ticketing.helloasso_disconnect_confirm: The entire HelloAsso configuration will be deleted, along with the rates, options and orders imported from this ticketing system. Anything entered manually is kept. This action cannot be undone.
ticketing.infomaniak_disconnect_confirm_detail: Its {tarifs} rate(s) and {options} option(s) will be permanently deleted. | Its {tarifs} rate(s), {options} option(s) and {count} imported order will be permanently deleted — anything entered manually is kept. | Its {tarifs} rate(s), {options} option(s) and {count} imported orders will be permanently deleted — anything entered manually is kept.
ticketing.quotas_card_description: Cap the number of participants on a show, a workshop or a meal.
ticketing.quotas_description: Caps that limit a number of participants — the seats of a show, a workshop, a meal. A quota attaches to tiers, options or custom fields, and counts the tickets that match them.
ticketing.assign_quotas_all_organizers_hint: These quotas apply to every organiser of the edition, including those added later.
ticketing.assign_quotas_per_organizer_hint: These quotas are added to those of all organisers. A registered organiser takes their place right away; validating their entry adds them to the validated entries.
ticketing.assign_quotas_all_volunteers_hint: These quotas apply to every volunteer whose application is accepted, including those accepted later.
ticketing.assign_quotas_per_team_hint: These quotas are added to those of all volunteers, they do not replace them. A volunteer in several teams only takes one place.
ticketing.assign_quotas_all_artists_hint: These quotas apply to every artist of the edition, including those added later.
ticketing.assign_quotas_per_show_hint: The show's artists take a place. An artist performing in two shows linked to the same quota only takes one.
ticketing.handout_items_disable_confirm: This edition has {count} handout item(s) configured. If you disable them, access control will stop asking for them: nothing will be handed out to attendees, volunteers, artists or organisers. Your settings are kept and will come back if you enable it again.
ticketing.handout_items_off_description: It is disabled for this edition: access control does not ask for any item. Your existing settings are kept and will come back if you enable it again.
ticketing.handout_items_disable_confirm_unknown: We could not check whether handout items are configured for this edition. If you disable them, access control will stop asking for them: nothing will be handed out. Your settings are kept and will come back if you enable it again.
ticketing.stats_compare_axis_hint: The axis counts days from each edition's opening: D1 is the first day, D-1 the day before.
ticketing.stats_compare_denied: You do not have access to this edition's statistics.
ticketing.stats_compare_error: The compared edition's statistics could not be loaded.
ticketing.handout_volumes_description: What you need to have, what has already gone out, and what is left to hand out. An item counts as handed out as soon as the person's entry is validated.
ticketing.handout_volumes_empty: No handout items are defined for this edition.
ticketing.handout_volumes_error: Could not calculate the quantities to plan for.
ticketing.handout_volumes_pending: Not collected yet — {count} person | Not collected yet — {count} people
ticketing.affluence_dedup_notice: {entrees} validated entries for {personnes} distinct people: someone present in several capacities is counted only once. Matching is done on the email address of the ticket or the account — so it is an estimate.
ticketing.affluence_description: The number of people on site at a given moment, broken down by population. A person is counted once, in their most involved role: organiser, then artist, then volunteer, then attendee. Tickets that do not count as attendees are excluded. The dashed curve is the expected headcount: everyone holding a ticket or a role, regardless of whether their entry was validated — the gap with the areas is what has not arrived yet.
ticketing.affluence_dedup_warning: The gap is large: some tickets probably share the email address of whoever paid, and are then counted as one person. Filling in each attendee's address sharpens the figure.
ticketing.affluence_expected_total: {count} person expected in total | {count} people expected in total
